_note: LIFE-05 overheard villager chat (writer 2026-10-13). Key life.chat.<a>.<b>.<n> (npc ids) falls back to life.chat.any.<n>. Each key = two talk turns. Also holds goblin lore/barks (D-072, no gameplay yet), ow.hesk.goblins.* (after mq.ow.names) and hint.sea.monster.1 (Burl hint, not placed).

life.chat.any.3.text: Let it. Better than the quiet.

life.chat.any.4.text: Has anyone seen my good knife?

life.chat.any.5.text: Wind's off the Wall today. Smell it?
Coal smoke. I don't miss it.

life.chat.any.6.text: Another nail gone from the fence.

life.chat.any.7.text: Rain by dusk. Get the hides in.
And the bread. Last time it drowned.

life.chat.any.8.text: Do you still dream of the Low Wards?
Every night. Then I wake here. Better.

life.chat.hesk.dorrin.2.text: At that anvil past dark again.
Cold forge. Nothing to burn but time.

life.chat.hesk.dorrin.3.text: The boy asked about flying again.
Then show him the sea. It's closer.

life.chat.hesk.dorrin.4.text: You hear it too? The call.
Every night. I just stopped saying so.

lore.goblins.1.text: Small, wiry, quick. They come down off the west hills.

lore.goblins.2.text: They want metal more than meat: nails, hinges, brass.

lore.goblins.3.text: Their camps are nests of scrap, lit by stolen fire.

lore.goblins.4.text: The village has iron, fire, geese. They want all three.

lore.goblins.5.text: In Ferrum they are a nursery tale. Out here, they bite.

lore.goblins.6.text: They keep west of the river. Hesk says they won't swim.

ow.hesk.goblins.1.text: Torches on the west hill. Goblins. Bar the pen, Wick.

ow.hesk.goblins.2.text: Barley gate hinge? Goblins. Then I took the brass.

hint.sea.monster.1.text: Deep water's got a thing in it bigger than me, sky-cub.
